MUTUAL NON-DISCLOSURE AGREEMENT

This Agreement is made on 4 October 2026 between Larkspur Software Inc. ("Larkspur") and Meridian Grid Partners LLP ("Meridian").

SECTION 1. CONFIDENTIALITY OBLIGATIONS
Each party agrees to hold the other party's Confidential Information in strict confidence and to use it solely for the Purpose.
The Recipient may share Confidential Information with its Representatives who are bound by duties of confidence at least as protective as this Agreement.

SECTION 2. EXCLUSIONS
Confidential Information does not include information that (i) is or becomes publicly available through no fault of the Recipient, (ii) the Recipient already lawfully knew, (iii) the Recipient independently develops, or (iv) the Recipient lawfully receives from a third party without restriction.

SECTION 3. TERM
The Recipient's obligations under this Agreement continue for twenty-four (24) months from the date of each disclosure.
This Agreement does not renew automatically.

SECTION 4. RETURN OF MATERIALS
On written request, the Recipient shall promptly return or destroy the Discloser's Confidential Information, except copies kept under a routine backup process.

SECTION 5. SURVIVAL
Termination does not affect rights or obligations that accrued before termination.

SECTION 6. GOVERNING LAW AND JURISDICTION
English law governs this Agreement.
Any dispute arising from this Agreement shall be brought only in the English courts.

SECTION 7. GENERAL
This Agreement is the entire agreement of the parties on its subject and may be amended only in writing signed by both parties. Neither party may assign this Agreement without the other party's written consent.

SECTION 8. DEFINITIONS
"Confidential Information" means all non-public business, technical and financial information disclosed by or for a party, in any form.
"Purpose" means evaluating a possible commercial relationship between the parties.
"Representatives" means a party's employees, officers and professional advisers who need to know Confidential Information for the Purpose.
"Effective Date" means the date of this Agreement.

Signed for Larkspur Software Inc. and for Meridian Grid Partners LLP by their authorised signatories.

(a) Each party's total liability arising out of this Agreement shall not exceed two (2) times the fees paid or payable by Customer in the twelve (12) months before the event giving rise to the claim.
(b) The limits in this Section do not apply to a party's breach of confidentiality or to Supplier's obligations under the intellectual property indemnity.

6. Term and Renewal
(a) This Agreement starts on the Effective Date and continues for an initial term of twenty-four (24) months.
(b) This Agreement renews automatically for successive one-year periods unless either party gives sixty (60) days' written notice of non-renewal.

(a) "Order Form" means an ordering document signed by both parties that references this Agreement.

contract.text:
MASTER SERVICES AGREEMENT

This Agreement is made on 2 October 2026 between Larkspur Software Inc. ("Customer") and Meridian Grid Partners LLP ("Supplier").

1. Services. Supplier shall provide the services described in each order form (the "Services") to Customer.

2. Fees. Customer shall pay undisputed fees within thirty (30) days of receiving a valid invoice.

3. Confidentiality. Each party shall protect the other party's confidential information with at least reasonable care and use it only to perform this Agreement.

4. Intellectual Property Indemnity. Supplier shall defend Customer against any third-party claim that the Services infringe that third party's intellectual property rights and shall pay the resulting damages and costs.

5. Limitation of Liability. Each party's total liability arising out of this Agreement is limited to the fees paid by Customer in the three (3) months before the claim. The limits in this Section do not apply to either party's indemnification obligations, except that Supplier's total liability for intellectual property claims shall not exceed the fees paid in the twelve (12) months before the claim.

6. Term and Renewal. This Agreement starts on the Effective Date and continues for an initial term of twelve (12) months. This Agreement renews automatically for successive one-year periods unless either party gives sixty (60) days' written notice of non-renewal.

7. Governing Law and Disputes. Delaware law governs this Agreement. Each party submits to the exclusive jurisdiction of the state and federal courts located in the State of Delaware for any dispute arising out of this Agreement.

8. General. This Agreement is the entire agreement of the parties on its subject and may be amended only in writing signed by both parties. Neither party may assign this Agreement without the other party's written consent.

9. Definitions. "Order Form" means an ordering document signed by both parties that references this Agreement. "Effective Date" means the date of the last signature below.

Signed for Larkspur Software Inc. and for Meridian Grid Partners LLP by their authorised signatories.
